name: cable standing jab v. 2
description: A second variation of the cable punch, built for quick power in the pushing muscles. Your trunk works to stay stable.
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable and hold the handle at chest height.
Step into a staggered stance and brace your core.
Punch forward fast and rotate your torso slightly.
Stop short of locking out your elbow.
Pull the hand back under control.
